# Usage Pulse

View local reports of your coding-agent activity.

| Maintenance | Dormant |
|---|---|
| Version | 0.1.13 |
| Clients | Codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code (legacy) |
| License | MIT |
| Source | [Repository](https://github.com/0langa/usage-pulse) |

**Dormant:** Available as-is, with no planned updates. Existing releases remain installable.

## Example request

> Show my Usage Pulse activity report for today.

## Requirements

Local Python plugin with host lifecycle hooks. Hook availability varies by client and execution environment.

- Python 3.11 or newer
- uv and Git
- A local host that supports the bundled hooks

## Install

### Codex

```shell
codex plugin marketplace add https://github.com/0langa/plugins.git
codex plugin add usage-pulse@0langas-plugins
```

### Claude Code

```shell
claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/0langa/plugins.git
claude plugin install usage-pulse@0langas-plugins
```

## Setup and use

- Install the plugin and start a new session. It records local activity counters through host hooks.
- Reports read the local Usage Pulse database. It does not store prompt bodies, sync data to a cloud service, or calculate pay-as-you-go charges.

## Legacy Kimi compatibility

Kimi compatibility is retained but is not actively tested. First prepare a [recursive checkout](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#development-checkout). Replace the example path with your checkout.

```text
/plugins marketplace C:\path\to\plugins\kimi-marketplace.json
/plugins install C:\path\to\plugins\plugins\usage-pulse
/reload
```
